newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway 12-month T-bill gets high yield of 5.20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Norway 12-month T-bill gets high yield of 5.20 pct.

text.p: Norway's Central Bank said on Monday a four billion crown expansion of the 12-month SS44 treasury bill produced a highest yield of 5.20 percent.
The lowest yield wa 5.15 percent and the weighted average was 5.18 percent. Bids for the highest accepted rate had a 75.2-percent allocation.
The T-bill was issued on September 12 with a nominal interest of 5.20 percent per annum. The inital issue was for 4.5 billion crowns, of which 500 million crowns were reserved for the bank.
